Configure liter-llm to extract text with a vision-capable model

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const xberg = @import("xberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"image/png\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png\"}", "{\"force_ocr\":true,\"ocr\":{\"backend\":\"vlm\",\"enabled\":true,\"language\":[\"eng\"],\"vlm_config\":{\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o-mini\",\"temperature\":0.0}}}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
